attempts.summary: Reworked the single-step logic so that each Start rising edge executes exactly one action from the predefined sequence. After the action completes, the block increments the step index and returns to idle, waiting for the next Start press. Single-cycle and continuous modes still run the full sequence automatically, with continuous restarting after the left position. Added explicit mode-change detection to reset the sequence, kept manual mode and emergency stop behaviour unchanged.
